This section hosts computational codebases, benchmark suites, and interactive physics simulations for PHYD57:

* **Interactive PDE Simulations:** In-browser HTML5 Canvas implementations of 2D wave equations, double-slit diffraction, and heat diffusion.
* **HPC Parallel Solvers:** 5-point Laplace stencils, SAXPY benchmarks, and OpenMP multi-threaded solvers in C and Modern Fortran.
* **GPU CUDA Kernels:** Fast Fourier Transform (CUFFT) convolution solvers, N-body particle simulators, and GPU acceleration.
